steps.note: The drink is soured with an acid that bacteria make from whey's lactose.
Fruit extracts, aromas, herb extracts and sugar or sweetener are put in.
The drink undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
